legacy.answer:
Published detection-frequency analysis for miyagi-regional-demo, 2020-01-01–2023-12-31 (Asia/Tokyo); one assay protocol.

Frequency = detected / eligible physical samples. An unsampled group has no rate. Low-support and partial periods retain their flags. These descriptive differences do not establish abundance, occupancy or causation.

Assay protocol: 12S · synthetic-amplicon-sequencing · PAIRED. The result cards retain the complete primer/PCR identity under “Instrument, primer and PCR definition”.
